declarations.docstring: The module structure on the scalar extension of a module over the scalar-extended algebra.
Scalar multiplication by the extended algebra agrees with evaluation of its action homomorphism on the extended module.
A splitting by linear maps after scalar extension to one algebra induces a splitting after further base change along an algebra homomorphism.
A linear equivalence between two scalar-extended modules induces one after further base change along an algebra homomorphism.
Transport a linear equivalence between scalar-extended modules along a homomorphism of commutative scalar algebras.
Transport a linear map between scalar-extended modules along a homomorphism of commutative scalar algebras.
The transported linear map sends a tensor introduced through cancellation of base change to the corresponding tensor of the original map value.
Transporting a composite linear map along base change equals the composite of the transported maps.
Transporting the identity linear map along base change yields the identity.
On a pure tensor over the target scalar algebra, the transported map is obtained by applying the original map to the unit tensor and then cancelling the intermediate base change.
The algebra homomorphism from the original algebra to scalar-linear endomorphisms of the scalar-extended module.
The algebra homomorphism from the scalar-extended algebra to scalar-linear endomorphisms of the scalar-extended module.
The scalar-extension action of a tensor with scalar component one on a pure module tensor applies the original algebra action to its module component.
An extended-algebra tensor with scalar component one acts on a pure module tensor through the original module action.
An extended-algebra tensor formed from a scalar and the algebra unit acts by scalar multiplication on the extended module.
